title: Proxmox · Galaxy Cluster
description: The cluster as Proxmox itself sees it: quorum, the five nodes, every guest, and the storages behind them.

options.content:
Galaxy as one machine: does it have quorum, and is everything that should be running actually running.

---

panels.title: Guests stopped
panels.description: Stopped is not always wrong — templates and spare guests live here too.

panels.title: Guests with no backup
panels.description: Proxmox reports a guest as not backed up when no vzdump archive exists for it on any storage it can see. It says nothing about backups taken outside Proxmox.

options.content:
The five machines under the cluster. Click a node to open its own dashboard.

panels.title: Node summary
panels.description: Proxmox's own view of each node, from the PVE API rather than from node_exporter. The two disagree slightly by design: this one counts a node's memory the way the hypervisor does.

options.content:
Every VM and container the cluster knows about, including templates.

panels.title: Every guest
panels.description: Sorted by CPU. A guest name links to that host's own dashboard where one exists; the two templates and kali-pen have no node_exporter, so those links go nowhere.
